footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Summit Midstream: includes a $501K income tax benefit; after $4.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 30.8% to $562M in 2025. Gross margin was 73.5%, versus 73.2% a year earlier, and operating income rose 78.4% to $71.8M, a 12.8% margin.
The net loss narrowed to $5.9M, or −$1.61 per share, from $122M. Operating cash flow was $134M and free cash flow $44.6M, versus $8.2M.
watch: Net income includes a $501K tax benefit.
sources: Summit Midstream Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

revenueLine.say: Rockies made up 59 percent of revenue.
